parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.sprs_score, p.far_above_score, p.current_phase, p.status, o.name as org_name, o.id as org_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN pc.status = 'fully_implemented' THEN 1 END) as complete_count, COUNT(pc.id) as total_count FROM programs p JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN program_controls pc ON p.id = pc.program_id WHERE o.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.sprs_score, p.far_above_score, p.current_phase, p.status, o.name, o.id ORDER BY o.name, p.name
INSERT INTO activity_log (event_type, description, metadata) VALUES ('weekly_digest', $1, $2::jsonb)
